title: Ritchie Hill

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Ritchie Hill is available for private events Monday-Sunday, and on select holidays. Hourly event rates include full, exclusive access to the property . We offer a flexible indoor and outdoor spaces that can be used in combination to host a truly historic event for 175 guests. There are multiple landscaped outdoor areas with an expansive 1900 square foot grand porch for events. Our interior space includes a formal dining room, three additional formal rooms, two handicap accessible bathrooms, a catering prep kitchen and is typically used for catering & bar services, dessert and dancing needs. blurb: Welcome to Ritchie Hill, a southern estate designed and restored to host truly historic events. Located in Concord's Historic District, only a short distance from Charlotte, NC, Ritchie Hill features a landmark residence with four acres of gardens and outdoor entertaining space.
